## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

Then select iPhone in Xcode and press `Cmd + R` to install.

MattoYuzuru/Mnema.body:
# Mnema

Mnema helps you learn from your own materials. You save a summary, a word, or a fragment of text as a `LearningItem`, turn it into exercises, and work through them in study sessions. A repetition schedule explains why material came back today.

The repository is a new implementation of the product that fully replaced the first version. Old APIs, `/v2` routes, dual read and write, and backward compatibility with v1 are not supported.

## What already works

- **Accounts.** The Identity & Account service: registration, sign-in via OAuth 2.0/OIDC with PKCE, sessions, profile, avatar, and account deletion.
- **Materials.** The Learning API stores private decks and their `LearningItem`s with immutable revisions. The editor supports text, images, audio, video, YouTube, Mermaid, and tables, drafts, and quick notes (Capture).
- **Exercises.** Seven mechanics: recall and self-check (`SELF_CHECK`), free-response input (`FREE_RESPONSE`), cloze fill-in-the-blanks (`CLOZE`), multiple choice (`CHOICE`), matching (`MATCH`), ordering (`ORDER`), and categorizing into groups (`CATEGORIZE`). The prompt, options, and items can combine text and media. The author writes an exercise on a single page: chooses…

Neytoph/quadro-builder.body:
# Quadro Builder

A browser-based designer for QUADRO climbing frames, made by Xiaomaifang. Open the web page and build on the official grid: edit in the browser, publish your models, record your household parts in inventory, list surplus accessories for sale, and export assembly manuals when you're done. `.qdf` files can be opened in both this tool and the original manufacturer's software. AI design is not yet available.

Online: [xiaomaifang.com/builder](https://xiaomaifang.com/builder/)

QUADRO is the original manufacturer's trademark. This is an unofficial community tool.

## Features

1. **Online editing**: Build in the browser with no software to install. Connectable positions light up.
2. **Model community**: Models in the plaza can be opened, edited, and published.
3. **Inventory management**: Record what you have at home. After building, compare to see what you're still missing.
4. **Accessory trading**: List surplus parts for sale, or post wanted requests for missing ones. Contact each other directly. The platform does not inspect goods or handle transactions.
5. **Assembly manual**: Build up layer by layer. The parts used in each step are shown alongside.
6. **AI design**: Describe in one sentence what you want to build, get a first draft, then edit it yourself. Not yet available.

## Feature Showcase

Workbench: Select parts from the top bar, change colors in the left panel, and build directly in the grass scene.

Model library: About 495 official models. Click a card to open and edit it.

Parts list: Pipes, fittings, boards, and screws are listed by category. Click a row to highlight it in the scene.

Layer-by-layer assembly: Scroll from bottom to top. The current layer is highlighted, and the parts used in that step are shown alongside.

Assembly instructions: Export a PDF from the top-left corner. The cover shows the front and back of the finished product and a total parts table. Each following step gets its own page, printed front and back, listing the parts for that step. Below are the cover and step 1 exported from the official model Play Castle (A0036).

Interface languages: 中 (Chinese) / EN / DE. Can be installed as a PWA. Previously cached pages can be opened offline.

When the window is narrowed, the left panel and three buttons move below the toolbar so they don't overlap.

## How to Use

The first time you open it, a guide highlights the real buttons on the interface. "File → Replay Guide" brings it back at any time.

1. **Getting started**
  In the right panel, "Model Library" opens official models. Or pick units from "Starter Models": basic geometry, play units (guardrail platform, steps, slide tower, tunnel house, twin-tower bridge, climbing tripod, swing door frame, sandbox frame), and roofs. Click a unit to attach it to the pointer. Placing it on an existing model merges them. You can also choose "Pipe" in the top bar and click an empty scene to grow your first pipe.
2. **Building**
  Select a part in the top bar and click a highlighted position in the scene to install it. Change colors in the left panel. Made a mistake? Undo it, or press D to enter delete mode and click the part to remove it.
3. **Checking inventory**
  "Parts List" shows what you've used. "My Inventory" lets you enter how many you have. "Purchase Suggestions" lists the parts you're missing and which kits to buy. Under the parts list, you can export the bill of materials as a table (CSV, opens directly in Excel; once inventory is filled in, it adds "Owned" and "Missing" columns) or as an image (with thumbnails, for sharing in a group chat).
4. **Safety check**
  Top right, "Safety" checks your build item by item against QUADRO's official safety notices: unsupported pipe ends, no pipe under board edges, 40×20 pieces over 60 cm…

QiuYeDx/FusionKit.description: A cross-platform desktop toolbox built on Electron for local subtitle transcription, AI subtitle translation, format conversion, filename translation, and audio tools, supporting macOS and Windows.
QiuYeDx/FusionKit.body:
**FusionKit** is a cross-platform desktop application for subtitle and translation work. It brings local audio and video transcription, AI subtitle translation and revision, format conversion, and batch export together in one workspace, and includes **FusionKit Agent**: describe what you want in a sentence, and the Agent finds files, prepares tasks, and completes the whole workflow after you confirm.

- **All-in-one subtitle workbench**: transcription, translation, proofreading, previewing the original audio, and export, all in one place.
- **Local first**: audio and video transcription uses Whisper models on your device, so media files are not uploaded; subtitle documents are stored on your machine.
- **Reviewable and reversible**: every AI edit shows a diff preview first and is written only after you confirm, and it can be undone.
- **Bring your own model service**: the app does not provide a model API, so AI features require your own API Key. DeepSeek, OpenAI, and any OpenAI-compatible endpoint are supported, and token usage and estimated cost are visible in real time.

## Features

### Subtitle Workbench

Manage subtitles as documents you can keep editing. They are not lost when you close and reopen the app.

- **Import and organize**: import and export SRT, LRC, VTT, ASS, SSA, and SBV. When you import bilingual subtitles, they are automatically split into source and translation text, and multiple translation tracks can be kept.
- **Transcription**: drag in audio or video, choose the audio track, model, and VAD, and generate subtitles locally. You can set transcription to automatically translate when finished and automatically export next to the media file.
- **Translation and revision**: translate an entire document or selected subtitles, optionally using terms and requirements from translation reference materials. Describe the changes you want in natural language (for example, “standardize how personal names are written” or “correct misrecognized words”), and the AI gives revisions and diffs for each item, then applies them all at once after you confirm.
- **Proofreading**: edit source and translated text inline, merge, split, and insert subtitles, and change timing and shift all timestamps. Listen to the original audio for each line, re-time with keyboard shortcuts while listening, or re-recognize selected lines with a local model.
- **Batch operations**: search, filter, and select across pages, then translate, export, or delete in bulk. All edits support undo and redo.

### FusionKit Agent

On the home page, a conversation drives the whole application:

- Query workbench documents, import subtitles, and prepare transcription and translation tasks. You can assign a whole chain at once, such as “transcribe → translate → save subtitles,” and the Agent asks for settings, completes the work automatically, and reports the results.
- Call tools for subtitle translation, format conversion, language extraction, filename translation, and more, and read the real progress of tasks. Complex requests produce a visible execution plan.
- Three execution modes: **Add only**, **Ask before executing**, and **Execute automatically**. Except in automatic execution, any operation that writes data is shown as a card and takes effect only after you confirm.
- Organize translation reference materials, and optionally enable online lookup to verify name translations (off by default; only search terms are sent).
- Sessions can be exported and imported, with context usage, token usage, and cost shown in real time.

On other pages, the Agent entry in the lower-left corner expands a floating panel that shares the same session as the home page. Agent…

TDesignOteam/tdesign-api.body:
# TDesign API Maintenance Tool

## Local Setup

Run `pnpm i` to install dependencies, then run `pnpm dev`. Once it succeeds, open http://127.0.0.1:16001/api_design locally to view the API design page.

## Features

### Main Interface

You can create, read, update, and delete component API entries in the main interface.

### Generate API

Click the "Generate API Files" button, choose the component and tech stack/framework platform, and confirm. The corresponding md documents, API definition files, and other files will be generated locally in the matching repository directory under `packages/products/`.

### Submit

After generating the files locally and modifying the data in the db, submit all changes to the repository as a PR and ask other team members to review it. Once the PR is merged, a GitHub Action will automatically use the committed content to create a branch in the corresponding TDesign component repository and commit the changed code, using the @github-actions github-actions[bot] account.

Example: https://github.com/TDesignOteam/tdesign-api/pull/12

You can open a PR yourself, or ask developers to continue the implementation on the corresponding branch.

Example: https://github.com/TDesignOteam/tdesign-react-test/pull/6

### Command Line Operations

Pull the API definition file for the Button component from a tech stack repository. Place the component repository in a sibling directory, then run the script, e.g. npm run api:docs Button 'Vue(PC)' finalProject

For more commands, see [Command Line Operations](https://github.com/TDesignOteam/tdesign-api/blob/HEAD/packages/scripts/README.md)

devonmochi/byetype.body:
# ByeType

ByeType is a Markdown-driven AI voice input tool. You can freely define rules, set custom vocabulary, and choose output styles, without being limited by the fixed dictionaries and restricted customization options of traditional input methods. The model understands the raw audio directly and handles person names, industry terms, number formatting, spoken-language cleanup, and mixed Chinese-English content during transcription. You can finish speaking with your eyes closed and send right away without checking whether the recognition is correct: what you say is what gets sent.

ByeType is free and open source, and uses your own API Key. It supports macOS and Windows, and iPhone and iPad through iOS Shortcuts.

## 📱 iPhone / iPad

With iOS Shortcuts, you can get the same custom vocabulary and transcription results on your phone and tablet as on the desktop version.

| Shortcut | Model | Install |
|---------|------|------|
| Byetype Qwen | Qwen 3.8 Omni Flash | [Add to Shortcuts](https://www.icloud.com/shortcuts/7db041829de14faa964b02369a23d8cc) |

> After installing, you need to fill in your own API Key, rules, and vocabulary in the Shortcut. It shares the same Key as the desktop version.

## 🏆 Why Choose ByeType

| | ByeType | Built-in system voice input | Whisper-style local solutions |
|---|---|---|---|
| Install size | **About 8MB** | Built into the system | 1–6GB (model files) |
| Customization | **Edit Markdown prompts** | Not supported | Can only add hotwords |
| Names and terms | **Corrected by prompts during transcription** | Not supported | Requires a further LLM pass |
| Formatting | **Numbers, symbols, casing, automatic line breaks** | None | Requires a further LLM pass |
| Multi-scenario switching | **Each hotkey can be bound to one output style** | Not supported | Not supported |
| Mixed Chinese-English | **Can be corrected using a vocabulary list** | Cannot be customized | Can only add hotwords |

> Whisper-style solutions convert speech to text first, then have an LLM process the text. ByeType has the multimodal large model process the raw audio directly, applying prompt rules during transcription.

## 🔬 Real-World Comparison

### Ordinary Voice Output

Has punctuation but no paragraph breaks, names all wrong, terms turned into homophones, filler words left in place:

> Um, so yesterday <u>**Zhang Yu**</u> and <u>**Qin Min**</u> got together for a bit, and they said that the <u>**deep seek v3**</u> project that <u>**Qu Hua**</u> is responsible for, running on <u>**mac mini m4**</u>, has <u>**因弗伦斯**</u> latency of about <u>**two hundred milliseconds**</u>, and the results are pretty good. MMH (MoneyMoneyHome) is a local-first intelligent financial workbench for families and individuals. It brings daily bookkeeping, credit card statements, funds, stocks, bonds, deposits, wealth management products, real estate, insurance, loans, and receivables/payables into one ledger, giving your household a single, long-term, stable view of its assets and liabilities.

jianghaisi/lanjian.description: Lanjian (岚笺): a local workbench for long-form novel writing
jianghaisi/lanjian.body:
Lanjian (岚笺) is a local novel-writing tool. The manuscript, reference materials, character profiles, outlines, and story events all live in the same book project. You can write on your own, or connect a model, ask the AI assistant (助笔) to discuss a plot passage, and then decide which content to keep.

The current release is **0.1 Developer Preview**, which provides a Windows x64 installer. Many details still need polishing, and feedback is welcome from anyone who tries it with real writing problems. Keep backups of important works.

## Why Lanjian

When writing a long novel, there is a lot of tedious work beyond typing: checking what a character said earlier, finding an inspiration you noted a few days ago, confirming the order of two events, and syncing a revised setting into the outline. With a lot of material, flipping back and forth between documents, notes, and chat logs can easily break your train of thought.

Lanjian aims to bring this work together. Open a book and you can find its manuscript, characters, references, and plans. When you get stuck, you can also discuss the problem with the book's background at hand, without re-explaining it every time.

AI can take part, but the writing decisions remain with the author. Results from a discussion are first offered for you to review, changes are traceable, and content goes into the work only when you choose to use it. Even without AI, you can start from a blank draft and write page by page.

## Take a look at the desktop app

The following are **actual screenshots taken after installing the Windows desktop version 0.1.0**, captured on 2026-10-12. The works, characters, and materials shown are separately entered sample data; there are no private manuscripts and no fabricated model replies. [Screenshot source](https://github.com/jianghaisi/lanjian/blob/HEAD/docs/assets/README.md)

### Library and covers

When you open Lanjian, you first see your own works. The library keeps the chapter you were last writing, word counts, and last edit times, so you can pick up where you left off or import existing manuscripts. Each book has its own card and cover; cover styles and layout will continue to be refined.

### Manuscript editing

The chapter directory is on the left and the manuscript is in the middle. Find and replace, layout, comments, follow-input, and focus mode are all near the editing area, and save status and version history can be viewed at any time. When you need to discuss a sentence or a plot passage, open the smart assistant on the right.

You can edit manually without configuring a model. Existing manuscripts can be imported from TXT, Markdown, or Word, and finished content can be exported.

### Book definition

Write down the core concept of the book first, then gradually add genre, length, point of view, and writing style. Volume count, chapters per volume, and words per chapter are planning references and can be adjusted as the story develops. Requirements you don't want to repeat to the model every time can also be kept here.

### References and inspiration

A single reference card can hold the original text, its source, and your own judgment. Quick inspiration notes, manually compiled materials, and content gathered from online research each have their own entry point. Finding a reference does not mean it has become a novel setting; deciding whether to use it is still up to you.

### Characters and world settings

Characters, locations, items, organizations, and world rules can each be filed separately. Public settings, author notes, and secrets not yet revealed are recorded apart, which makes them easier to find when you look back later. For xianxia, xuanhuan, or system-based genres, there are entries for realms and power levels, golden-finger abilities, and fixed system templates.

lingeringdawn/pan-fetcher.body:
# pan-fetcher · 115 Cloud Drive RSS BT Download Subscription Tool

---

An automatic tool for tracking anime and TV series. Search for resources → add subscriptions → automatically push to 115 offline downloads, with the full workflow managed from a web panel. Supports Cookies / QR code login. All operations go through the official 115 API.

## ✨ Features

### 🎬 TMDB Discovery

Search for movies and TV shows, view full details (posters, synopses, ratings, genres), and jump to aggregated search with one click to find resources.

### 🔍 Aggregated Search

Based on Jackett, with hundreds of indexers. Tag filtering, keyword filtering, and paginated browsing. Search results are automatically deduplicated.

By default, it **filters out entries whose titles do not contain the search term**. Indexer sites match loosely, and short show titles often bring up many irrelevant results, so enabling this significantly reduces noise. It can be turned off on the settings page.

### 📡 Jackett Integration

Two usage modes, switchable on the settings page:

- **Built-in Jackett** (default): Automatically detects the local instance and reads its configuration (including the API Key). If none is detected, it can be downloaded, installed, and started with one click. Before installation, the runtime environment is checked (distribution, glibc, ICU libraries, disk space, permissions), and missing system dependencies can be installed with one click. Supports version detection, one-click updates, and uninstallation (indexer configuration is kept by default).
- **External Jackett**: Use an instance you deploy yourself (on this machine or another one). You only need to enter its address and API Key. This program does not download, start, or modify its files.

Automatically discovers all indexers in the instance, with batch management and connection testing. Search results are labeled with their source, and the indexers that participate in search can be selected independently.

> Searches use the standard Torznab protocol.

### 📋 RSS Subscriptions

Scheduled fetching, smart deduplication, keyword filtering, and cache management. Supports RSS aggregation from both local and Jackett indexers.

### 📥 Offline Downloads

Batch submission of magnet / ed2k / http links, status columns, and task cleanup.

### 📂 File Management

Browse, create, rename, move, copy, and delete directories on 115 Cloud Drive.

### 📊 Dashboard

Operational overview: push statistics, subscription status, indexer count, cache entries, and recently added resources.

### 🔔 Notifications

WeCom (Enterprise WeChat) Webhook integration, with toggles for multiple notification types.

### 📜 Runtime Logs

Real-time log output, newest first, with auto-refresh for easier troubleshooting.

### ⚙️ Easy Deployment

One-click Docker deployment, Linux systemd install script, prebuilt Linux binaries (amd64 / arm64), and web-based configuration.

The panel has built-in **update checking and one-click self-update**. After upgrading, configuration (including subscription filter keywords and Jackett connection info) remains unchanged.

## 🚀 Quick Start

> **Linux only.** pan-fetcher relies on Linux process and file semantics (self-update, subprocess detachment, Jackett installation) and does not support Windows / macOS.

liuxie066/options-monitor.body:
`options-monitor` is a locally run options monitoring system that prioritizes human decisions. It links market data, cash, underlying stock positions, the options ledger, strategy rules, reports, and notifications into an auditable chain, helping users complete:

- `Cash-Secured Put (CSP)` and `Covered Call (CC)` candidate screening;
- `Combo Yield` combination candidate evaluation;
- When Wheel is enabled, external CSP / CC assignments that meet identity and delivery evidence requirements enter the corresponding rotation branch;
- `Close Advice` for opened option lots;
- Queries for option profit, cash activity, positions, and expiration lifecycle;
- Daily Decision Brief, candidate change alerts, and offline strategy review.

It is not an automated trading system and does not place orders on the user's behalf. Candidates, close advice, and research conclusions are all advisory-only. Real trades, config writes, notification sending, service changes, and production state modifications must each go through their own explicit confirmation boundary.

## Core boundaries

The system has only one main runtime chain:

```text
config.yaml
├─ om config build --market us|hk
│  └─ config.us.json / config.hk.json
│     └─ om run tick | om run tick-cron
│        └─ output_runs + output_shared + output_accounts
└─ om config build-bot
   └─ resolved/config.bot.json
```

Option positions have only one fact chain:

```text
trade_events -> projection -> position_lots
```

- `config.yaml` is the manually edited source. The generated JSON files are runtime snapshots, not the entry point for day-to-day manual editing.
- The local SQLite database is the source of truth for option trades and positions. Feishu does not carry an `option_positions` mirror.
- Futu account cash is read through the shared entry point, which determines its credibility. Scanning, queries, reports, Wheel, and assignment scenarios all use the same cash standard. Validity is uniformly controlled by `runtime.portfolio_context_ttl_sec`. When evidence is missing, it is explicitly marked as unavailable.
- Ordinary manual `tick` runs do not automatically send scheduled ordinary notifications. Production scheduling uses the protected `tick-cron`.
- `./om-agent spec` is the authoritative list of Tool Gateway tool names, input schemas, risk levels, and side effects.
- The current exchange rate uniformly uses the latest valid quote. During verified consecutive market closures, carried-over prices may also be used for open-position screening and capital capacity calculations, retaining the real quote time. When a price is missing during trading hours or the source cannot be verified, it is explicitly marked as unavailable.

mengxiaoww/linuxdo-threaded-reader.body:
# Linux DO Threaded Reading

Chain replies together by their discussion relationships, or switch back to a quote mode that reads in floor order.

**Current version: v6.1.2** · [Forum sharing and feedback](https://linux.do/t/topic/3021097) · [Changelog](https://github.com/mengxiaoww/linuxdo-threaded-reader/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md)

## Installation / Update

1. Install a userscript manager such as Tampermonkey in your browser, and allow access to `linux.do`.
2. [Open the full script](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mengxiaoww/linuxdo-threaded-reader/main/linuxdo-comments.user.js). If the manager shows an install page, follow the prompts; otherwise copy all the code, create a new script in the manager, and fully replace its contents.
3. After saving, refresh any topics that are already open. When updating from an older version, replace the original script to avoid running two copies at once.

The script in the repository keeps its original formatting and is not minified. The download file is at [linuxdo-comments.user.js](https://github.com/mengxiaoww/linuxdo-threaded-reader/blob/HEAD/linuxdo-comments.user.js).

## Features

- **Threaded replies**: Keeps a single discussion together and progresses by actual reply relationships, aligns same-level replies, and connects avatars with light gray bent lines; limits indentation on narrow screens.
- **Quote mode**: Restores the forum's original floor order and progress. Keeps the existing quotes, and only adds context for replies that lack a quote to the same parent comment.
- **Native actions**: Likes, replies, Boost, and solutions reuse the forum's components. Pre-loads the share, bookmark, flag, unread, and notification settings, and recommended topics at the bottom of the topic. Once the comment list settles, the footer fades in over 180ms; respects the system's reduced-motion setting. Successfully posted replies sync immediately to the corresponding discussion, keeping the current reading position; replies pending review or failed to submit are not shown as published.
- **Auto-pagination**: Long topics load up to 20 posts per batch and keep loading when near the bottom; after jumping to the end, scrolling up fetches the previous page and keeps the current comment position. When a parent comment is missing, its context is fetched separately without scanning hundreds of intermediate floors.
- **Native timeline**: Directly reuses the forum's timeline component, track, and drag preview, removing the custom slider. Provides a separate filtered list without altering the real post stream or pagination data. Threaded replies are counted by top-level reply; the first post and in-thread replies are not double-counted. `19 / 31` means the current item is the 19th of 31; the actual number loaded is listed separately. Can be clicked or dragged, and releasing navigates to the position; starting a new drag cancels the previous navigation request. Already-loaded targets scroll directly, while unloaded targets query only their single floor number and then open nearby pages. Jumping directly to the end does not mean all content in the middle has been read.

mihsian77/Emubox.body:
# EmuBox

> Download manager for drivers, components, and runtime libraries for Android and Windows emulation environments. Full Chinese interface, domestic download acceleration, and automatic device matching.

EmuBox is derived from [Rodrig02005/EmuHub-APP](https://github.com/Rodrig02005/EmuHub-APP) (MIT license, author Rodrigo Castro). On that base it redesigns the interface, resource directory, and download pipeline, targeting users of domestic (China) emulation environments such as Winlator / Eden / GameHub.

---

> Is GitHub rate-limiting APK downloads, or do you not want to install the app right now? You can use the [web version fallback](https://mihsian77.github.io/EmuHub/) (EmuHub navigation site, separate repository, archived and read-only) to download common drivers and components directly in your browser. The web version has limited features; for the full experience, use the app.

---

## Features

- **Driver section**: Turnip (Qualcomm Adreno), PanVK (ARM Mali), and Samsung Xclipse GPU drivers. Includes 48 built-in driver source records, categorized by GPU architecture, model, target platform, and maturity.
- **Component section**: Wine / Proton, Box64 / FEXCore / WOWBox64, DXVK / VKD3D-Proton / D7VK and other graphics and translation components, aggregating multiple upstream catalogs.
- **Runtime library section**: VC++ runtimes, .NET, codecs, fonts, DirectX, and other common Winlator dependencies, with Chinese usage notes and installation guides.
- **Device matching**: Automatically detects GPU model, Adreno / Mali generation, Android version, and RAM. Drivers are ranked by match score. This can be turned off in settings to view all drivers.
- **Domestic download acceleration**: Connects to acceleration nodes maintained by [MirrorHub](https://github.com/mihsian77/MirrorHub), with automatic speed testing to pick the best one. You can also switch nodes manually or turn acceleration off.
- **Download management**: Pause, resume, and resumable downloads. Files are stored in per-type directories. The download library can scan for locally existing files and show the `meta.json` information inside packages.
- **Component guide**: Explains each component's purpose, recommended choice, use cases, and when to switch.
- **Bilingual**: Simplified Chinese / English, switchable in settings.

## Download

Get the latest APK from [Releases](https://github.com/mihsian77/Emubox/releases). Minimum system requirement: Android 9.0 (API 28).

## Build

Requirements: JDK 17, Android SDK (compileSdk 37, NDK for native Vulkan capture).
